entries.ec090648fb2754b3: Under its management philosophy, and toward realizing its purpose of "Creativity × Tech: making the world more convenient and more fun," it aims for discontinuous growth through organic growth from existing businesses together with inorganic growth driven by M&A, and states that it promotes strengthening its business portfolio. Regarding M&A, it states that it will work on improving the quality and speed of the entire execution process, and on early integration and creating synergies after acquisition. It is working on this under a medium-term management plan (FY2025-FY2028).
